en: I

zh: 英国在十九世纪通过"非正式帝国"

的方式向海外扩张，其程度不亚于在严格的宪制意义上取得统治权——这一点本应已成常识。就经济分析而言，把帝国史仅仅界定为地图上被涂成红色的那些殖民地的历史，显然有违实际。然而，几乎所有帝国史的撰写，都建立在这样一个假设之上：仅凭正式统治就能理解帝国的历史，可以把这一历史从英国扩张和世界政治的背景中抽离出来。关于十九世纪帝国的通行解释，至今仍然只建立在对正式帝国的研究之上；这就好比单凭水面以上的部分来判断冰山的大小与性状。
en: It ought to be a commonplace that Great Britain during the nineteenth century expanded overseas by means of 'informal empire'

as much as by acquiring dominion in the strict constitutional sense. For purposes of economic analysis it would clearly be unreal to define imperial history exclusively as the history of those colonies coloured red on the map. Nevertheless, almost all imperial history has been written on the assumption that the empire of formal dominion is historically comprehensible in itself and can be cut out of its context in British expansion and world politics. The conventional interpretation of the nineteenth-century empire continues to rest upon study of the formal empire alone, which is rather like judging the size and character of icebergs solely from the parts above the water-line.

zh: 事实上，帝国史学家在很大程度上受制于他自己那个特定的帝国概念。他凭这个概念来判定哪些事实具有"帝国"意义；他的史料受限于他的概念，而他最后的解释本身也在很大程度上取决于其假设的范围。不同的假设导致了相互冲突的结论。既然帝国史学家们写的是不同的帝国，既然他们又是从帝国那些非典型或孤立的侧面作出概括，那么这些史学家有时彼此矛盾，就毫不足怪。
en: The imperial historian, in fact, is very much at the mercy of his own particular concept of empire. By that, he decides what facts are of 'imperial' significance; his data are limited in the same way as his concept, and his final interpretation itself depends largely upon the scope of his hypothesis. Different hypotheses have led to conflicting conclusions. Since imperial historians are writing about different empires and since they are generalizing from eccentric or isolated aspects of them, it is hardly surprising that these historians sometimes contradict each other.

zh: 关于十九世纪帝国史的正统观点，仍旧是从那个激发了帝国联邦运动的种族—法律观念的立场上定下来的。西利、埃杰顿一类史学家把正式帝国里的事件看作帝国活动的唯一检验标准；他们把以亲缘与宪政依附为纽带的帝国，看作一个自有其生长规律的有机体。就这样，十九世纪被划分为帝国主义时期与反帝国主义时期，划分的依据是正式帝国的扩展或收缩，以及人们对英国海外统治之价值的信仰程度。
en: The orthodox view of nineteenth-century imperial history remains that laid down from the standpoint of the racial and legalistic concept which inspired the Imperial Federation movement. Historians such as Seeley and Egerton looked on events in the formal empire as the only test of imperial activity; and they regarded the empire of kinship and constitutional dependence as an organism with its own laws of growth. In this way the nineteenth century was divided into periods of imperialism and anti-imperialism, according to the extension or contraction of the formal empire and the degree of belief in the value of British rule overseas.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，对"帝国主义"的另一种解释——它起初本是激进派抨击联邦主义论者的那场论战的一部分——实际上恰恰证实了对方的分析。那些把帝国主义看作资本主义的高级阶段、看作海外投资的必然结果的人，同样认为它在历史上只适用于 1880 年以后。结果，他们也被引向对帝国主义正式表现的同样专注，因为维多利亚晚期正是英国统治引人注目的扩展时代。于是，霍布森和列宁、穆恩教授和伍尔夫先生
从相反的立场，证实了其对手的论断：维多利亚晚期的帝国主义是英国扩张性质上的一次质变，是对世纪中叶那种清白而静止的自由主义的急剧背离。这一所谓的变化，一派欢迎，一派谴责，两派却都接受。
en: Ironically enough, the alternative interpretation of 'imperialism', which began as part of the radical polemic against the Federationists, has in effect only confirmed their analysis. Those who have seen imperialism as the high stage of capitalism and the inevitable result of foreign investment agree that it applied historically only to the period after 1880. As a result they have been led into a similar preoccupation with formal manifestations of imperialism because the late-Victorian age was one of spectacular extension of British rule. Consequently, Hobson and Lenin, Professor Moon and Mr Woolf

have confirmed from the opposite point of view their opponents' contention that late-Victorian imperialism was a qualitative change in the nature of British expansion and a sharp deviation from the innocent and static liberalism of the middle of the century. This alleged change, welcomed by one school, condemned by the other, was accepted by both.

zh: 尽管分歧如此，这两种学说指向的却是同一种解释：维多利亚中期对帝国的"冷漠"与维多利亚晚期对帝国的"热情"，与自由贸易信条的盛衰直接相关。列宁写道："当英国的自由竞争处于顶峰时，也就是在 1840 年至 1860 年间，英国主要的资产阶级政治家……认为殖民地获得解放、与英国完全分离，既不可避免，也是可取的。"
斯凯勒教授把这个时段延长到 1861 至 1870 这十年："……因为正是在这些年里，瓦解帝国的倾向达到了顶点。曼彻斯特学派的学说正处于其影响的顶峰。"
en: For all their disagreement these two doctrines pointed to one interpretation; that mid-Victorian 'indifference' and late-Victorian 'enthusiasm' for empire were directly related to the rise and decline in free-trade beliefs. Thus Lenin wrote: 'When free competition in Great Britain was at its height, i.e. between 1840 and 1860, the leading British bourgeois politicians were... of the opinion that the liberation of the colonies and their complete separation from Great Britain was inevitable and desirable.'

Professor Schuyler extends this to the decade from 1861 to 1870: '...for it was during those years that tendencies toward the disruption of the empire reached their climax. The doctrines of the Manchester school were at the height of their influence.'

zh: 论到世纪的最后四分之一，兰格教授认为，"显然存在英国〔出口〕市场被持续压缩的危险。因此扩张运动应运而生并骤然兴盛……曼彻斯特的学说已被事实证伪。它是一种过时的理论，该丢进废纸堆。"
他们的论证可以这样概括：维多利亚中期的正式帝国没有扩展，甚至看似正在瓦解，所以那个时期是反帝国主义的；维多利亚晚期的正式帝国迅速扩展，所以那是一个帝国主义时代；造成这一变化的原因是自由贸易观念已经过时。
en: In the last quarter of the century, Professor Langer finds that 'there was an obvious danger that the British [export] market would be steadily restricted. Hence the emergence and sudden flowering of the movement for expansion.... Manchester doctrine had been belied by the facts. It was an outworn theory to be thrown into the discard.'

Their argument may be summarized in this way: the mid-Victorian formal empire did not expand, indeed it seemed to be disintegrating, therefore the period was anti-imperialist; the later-Victorian formal empire expanded rapidly, therefore this was an era of imperialism; the change was caused by the obsolescence of free trade.

zh: 这一论证的麻烦在于，它漏掉了太多它自称要解释的事实。且看对帝国"冷漠"的十年带来了什么结果。1841 年至 1851 年间，英国占领或兼并了新西兰、黄金海岸、纳闽、纳塔尔、旁遮普、信德和香港。此后二十年间，英国又确立了对贝拉尔、奥德、下缅甸和九龙的统治，确立了对拉各斯及塞拉利昂近邻地区的统治，确立了对巴苏陀兰、格里夸兰和德兰士瓦的统治；并且在昆士兰和不列颠哥伦比亚建立了新殖民地。除非这种扩张可以用"一阵阵的心不在焉"来解释，否则我们就不得不面对这样一个悖论：它恰恰是在帝国当局决心避免扩展其统治的情况下发生的。
en: The trouble with this argument is that it leaves out too many of the facts which it claims to explain. Consider the results of a decade of 'indifference' to empire. Between 1841 and 1851 Great Britain occupied or annexed New Zealand, the Gold Coast, Labuan, Natal, the Punjab, Sind and Hong Kong. In the next twenty years British control was asserted over Berar, Oudh, Lower Burma and Kowloon, over Lagos and the neighbourhood of Sierra Leone, over Basutoland, Griqualand and the Transvaal; and new colonies were established in Queensland and British Columbia. Unless this expansion can be explained by 'fits of absence of mind', we are faced with the paradox that it occurred despite the determination of the imperial authorities to avoid extending their rule.

zh: 即便我们像正统观点所要求的那样，只把注意力限于正式帝国，这一矛盾依然存在。但若是把目光投向非正式帝国的地域，困难就变得大得无法应付。关于本世纪中叶南非政策的通常叙述是：英国放弃了控制内陆的任何打算。但事实上，看似从奥兰治河主权领和德兰士瓦的撤出，依据的不是关于殖民地种种麻烦的任何先验理论，而是更广阔格局中战略与商业的硬事实。英国身处南非，首先是为了保卫通往东方的航路，办法是防止外国列强在这些航路的侧翼取得基地。以这一方式或那一方式，这种帝国利益都要求对林波波河以南的非洲保持某种控制；尽管 1852 年至 1877 年间布尔各共和国并未因此被英国正式控制，英国却借助非正式的最高控制权以及这些共和国对英国港口的依赖，有效地支配着它们。只要我们不肯把视野缩窄到正式帝国，就能看出主要的帝国利益是如何靠着在整个地区维持优势而被何等稳定、何等成功地推进的，也能看出它在所谓反帝国主义时代里的推进，与在维多利亚晚期一样稳定。而这一点是靠把布尔各共和国同印度洋隔开来做到的：靠 1843 年兼并纳塔尔，靠 1860 年和 1868 年把布尔人挡在德拉戈阿湾之外，靠 1861 年和 1866 年把他们挡在圣卢西亚湾之外，靠 1860 年英国出面干预、阻止两个共和国在普列托里乌斯之下合并。
说来奇怪，正是斯凯勒视为反帝国主义顶峰的那届政府——第一届格拉斯通政府——为了"确保我们在南非诸领地的安全"，于 1868 年兼并了巴苏陀兰，于 1871 年兼并了西格里夸兰。
能靠非正式手段就靠非正式手段，必要时就正式兼并——英国的最高控制权就这样被稳定地维护着。
en: This contradiction arises even if we confine our attention to the formal empire, as the orthodox viewpoint would force us to do. But if we look beyond into the regions of informal empire, then the difficulties become overwhelming. The normal account of South African policy in the middle of the century is that Britain abandoned any idea of controlling the interior. But in fact what looked like withdrawal from the Orange River Sovereignty and the Transvaal was based not on any

theories about the inconveniences of colonies but upon hard facts of strategy and commerce in a wider field. Great Britain was in South Africa primarily to safeguard the routes to the East, by preventing foreign powers from acquiring bases on the flank of those routes. In one way or another this imperial interest demanded some kind of hold upon Africa south of the Limpopo River, and although between 1852 and 1877 the Boer Republics were not controlled formally for this purpose by Britain, they were effectually dominated by informal paramountcy and by their dependence on British ports. If we refuse to narrow our view to that of formal empire, we can see how steadily and successfully the main imperial interest was pursued by maintaining supremacy over the whole region, and that it was pursued as steadily throughout the so-called anti-imperialist era as in the late-Victorian period. But it was done by shutting in the Boer Republics from the Indian Ocean: by the annexation of Natal in 1843, by keeping the Boers out of Delagoa Bay in 1860 and 1868, out of St Lucia Bay in 1861 and 1866, and by British intervention to block the union of the two Republics under Pretorius in 1860.

Strangely enough it was the first Gladstone Government which Schuyler regards as the climax of anti-imperialism, which annexed Basutoland in 1868 and Griqualand West in 1871 in order to ensure 'the safety of our South African Possessions'.
By informal means if possible, or by formal annexations when necessary, British paramountcy was steadily upheld.

zh: 这些举措像是急于主持结束大英帝国的大臣会作出的吗？它们像是一个因自由贸易而变得多余的帝国所受到的"冷漠"吗？恰恰相反，这里存在着一种政策的连续性，而通行解释之所以看不到它，是因为它只计入正式的控制手段。它同样看不到英国海权所能维持的、对西非海岸与南太平洋的持续把握。拒绝兼并并不证明不愿控制。正如阿伯丁勋爵 1845 年所说："……无需补充的是，女王陛下政府不会无动于衷地看着另一个列强在这些地方建立保护统治——英国政府正是考虑到〔太平洋〕诸岛的真正利益，才拒绝实行这种保护统治。"
en: Are these the actions of ministers anxious to preside over the liquidation of the British Empire? Do they look like 'indifference' to an empire rendered superfluous by free trade? On the contrary, here is a continuity of policy which the conventional interpretation misses because it takes account only of formal methods of control. It also misses the continuous grasp of the West African coast and of the South Pacific which British sea-power was able to maintain. Refusals to annex are no proof of reluctance to control. As Lord Aberdeen put it in 1845: '... it is unnecessary to add that Her Majesty's Government will not view with indifference the assumption by another Power of a Protectorate which they, with due regard for the true interests of those [Pacific] islands, have refused.'

zh: 正统假设也无法解释整个维多利亚中期与晚期帝国宪制政策的明显连续性。如果给予殖民地责任政府是由于维多利亚中期对帝国的"冷漠"、甚至出于摆脱帝国的愿望，那么为什么这一政策在维多利亚晚期仍被继续推行——彼时英国最关心的莫过于维系帝国统一？人们通常假定自由贸易时代的英国政府认为帝国多余，这源于高估了法律形式变化的意义。事实上，在整个维多利亚时代，只要责任政府意味着牺牲或危及英国的最高控制权或利益，它就不会被授予殖民地。凡担心外国在所涉大陆或次大陆挑战英国优势之处，凡殖民地无力在财政上维持自身内部安全之处，帝国当局就保留全部责任；或者，若它们已经下放了这个责任，就直接干预以再度确保自身利益。换言之，责任政府远不是分离主义的设计，它只是把维护英国利益的手段由直接改为间接。通过在合适时机松弛正式的政治纽带，英国既可以依靠经济上的依附与相互的善意把殖民地系在自己身边，又可以把它们继续用作英国进一步扩张的中介。
en: Nor can the obvious continuity of imperial constitutional policy throughout the mid- and late-Victorian years be explained on the orthodox hypothesis. If the granting of responsible government to colonies was due to the mid-Victorian 'indifference' to empire and even a desire to be rid of it, then why was this policy continued in the late-Victorian period when Britain was interested above all in preserving imperial unity? The common assumption that British governments in the free-trade era considered empire superfluous arises from over-estimating the significance of changes in legalistic forms. In fact, throughout the Victorian period responsible government was withheld from colonies if it involved sacrificing or endangering British paramountcy or interests. Wherever there was fear of a foreign challenge to British supremacy in the continent or sub-continent concerned, wherever the colony could not provide financially for its own internal security, the imperial authorities retained full responsibility, or, if they had already devolved it, intervened directly to secure their interests once more. In other words, responsible government, far from being a separatist device, was simply a change from direct to indirect methods of maintaining British interests. By slackening the formal political bond at the appropriate time, it was possible to rely on economic dependence and mutual good-feeling to keep the colonies bound to Britain while still using them as agents for further British expansion.

zh: 事实与正统解释之间的不一致还有另一种表现。尽管人们辑录了大量据称敌视殖民地的言论，实际上究竟有多少殖民地遭到放弃？例如，1865 年的西非委员会为放弃西非诸据点中除一处之外的全部提出了有力而常被引用的理由，可就在他们开会的同时，这些据点正在被扩展。然而，传统解释中最扎眼的缺口是印度帝国。它在"冷漠时期"的历史充斥着战争与兼并。
en: The inconsistency between fact and the orthodox interpretation arises in yet another way. For all the extensive anthologies of opinion supposedly hostile to colonies, how many colonies were actually abandoned? For instance, the West Africa Committee of 1865 made a strong and much quoted case for giving up all but one of the West African settlements, but even as they sat these settlements were being extended. The Indian empire, however, is the most glaring gap in the traditional explanation. Its history in the 'period of indifference' is filled with wars and annexations.

zh: 此外，在这个所谓自由放任的时期，英国并未撤出印度，反而沿着最典型的重商主义路线，把印度当作经济殖民地大力开发。在英属印度拉吉的大部分时期里，统治权力都可以在印度以赋税和专卖的形式，榨取鸦片、食盐这类贵重初级产品。而且，所谓十九世纪末帝国主义扩张的特征，早在列宁认为经济帝国主义时代开始的那个年份（1880 年）之前很久，就已在印度发展起来。由政府直接扶植英国工业所需产品的生产，由政府操纵关税以帮助英国出口，以有担保的高利息筹资修建铁路、打开大陆腹地——所有这些直接政治控制的手段，其运用方式都与所谓自由放任时代格格不入。而且，它们——尤其是在铁路融资方面——与所谓强悍个人主义的神话几乎没有关系。"所有的钱都来自英国资本家，"一位英国官员写道，"只要印度的岁入能给他担保百分之五的回报，他借出的资金是扔进胡格利河还是砌成砖瓦，对他都无所谓。"
en: Moreover, in this supposedly laissez-faire period India, far from being evacuated, was subjected to intensive development as an economic colony along the best mercantilist lines. In India it was possible, throughout most of the period of the British Raj, to use the governing power to extort in the form of taxes and monopolies such valuable primary products as opium and salt. Furthermore, the characteristics of so-called imperialist expansion at the end of the nineteenth century developed in India long before the date (1880) when Lenin believed the age of economic imperialism opened. Direct governmental promotion of products required by British industry, government manipulation of tariffs to help British exports, railway construction at high and guaranteed rates of interest to open the continental interior—all of these techniques of direct political control were employed in ways which seem alien to the so-called age of laissez-faire. Moreover, they had little to do, particularly in railway finance, with the folk-lore of rugged individualism. 'All the money came from the English capitalist' as a British official wrote, 'and, so long as he was guaranteed five per cent on the revenues of India, it was immaterial to him whether the funds which he lent were thrown into the Hooghly or converted into bricks and mortar.'

zh: 总之：关于维多利亚帝国史的通行看法留下了一连串难以回答的问题。在"反帝国主义"时代，为什么所有殖民地都被保留下来？为什么又取得了多得多的殖民地？为什么建立了那么多新的势力范围？又或者，在"帝国主义"时代——我们稍后会看到——为什么对进一步兼并土地如此不情愿？为什么在反帝国主义推动下开始的权力下放仍在继续？在自由放任时代，为什么印度经济要靠国家来开发？
en: To sum up: the conventional view of Victorian imperial history leaves us with a series of awkward questions. In the age of 'anti-imperialism' why were all colonies retained? Why were so many more obtained? Why were so many new spheres of influence set up? Or again, in the age of 'imperialism', as we shall see later, why was there such reluctance to annex further territory? Why did decentralization, begun under the impetus of anti-imperialism, continue? In the age of laissez-faire why was the Indian economy developed by the state?

zh: 这些悖论太过根本，不能只当作"例外证明规则"来解释，也不能靠断言帝国政策大体非理性、前后不一、是一连串偶然与巧合的产物来打发。可以怀疑的是，矛盾来自史学家考察历史事实的方式，而非事实本身。一个能容纳更多事实的假设或许是：整个十九世纪的英国扩张存在根本的连续性。
en: These paradoxes are too radical to explain as merely exceptions which prove the rule or by concluding that imperial policy was largely irrational and inconsistent, the product of a series of accidents and chances. The contradictions, it may be suspected, arise not from the historical reality but from the historians' approach to it. A hypothesis which fits more of the facts might be that of a fundamental continuity in British expansion throughout the nineteenth century.

zh: II
en: II

zh: 所需要的假设必须同时容纳非正式扩张与正式扩张，并且必须考虑到这一过程的连续性。正如西利所指出的，十九世纪英国历史中最引人注目的事实，是它是一部不断扩张的社会的历史。资本与制成品的输出、国民的移居、英语、观念与宪制形式的传播，都是不列颠诸民族社会活力向外扩展的表现。1812 年至 1914 年间，两千多万人从不列颠群岛移居海外，其中近百分之七十去了帝国之外。
据估计，1815 年至 1880 年间累积在国外的债权达 £1,187,000,000（11.87 亿英镑），但投入正式帝国的不过六分之一。即便到 1913 年，£3,975,000,000（39.75 亿英镑）的海外投资中，位于帝国之内的也不到一半。
同样，整个世纪里没有哪一年帝国买走的英国出口品明显超过三分之一。基本事实是：英国的工业化引起了海外地区不断扩展、不断加深的开发。它们是否在形式上属于英国，是次要的考虑。
en: The hypothesis which is needed must include informal as well as formal expansion, and must allow for the continuity of the process. The most striking fact about British history in the nineteenth century, as Seeley pointed out, is that it is the history of an expanding society. The exports of capital and manufactures, the migration of citizens, the dissemination of the English language, ideas and constitutional forms, were all of them radiations of the social energies of the British peoples. Between 1812 and 1914 over twenty million persons emigrated from the British Isles, and nearly 70 per cent of them went outside the Empire.

Between 1815 and 1880, it is estimated, £1,187,000,000 in credit had accumulated abroad, but no more than one-sixth was placed in the formal empire. Even by 1913, something less than half of the £3,975,000,000 of foreign investment lay inside the Empire.

Similarly, in no year of the century did the Empire buy much more than one-third of Britain's exports. The basic fact is that British industrialization caused an ever-extending and intensifying development of overseas regions. Whether they were formally British or not, was a secondary consideration.

zh: 也许可以将帝国主义理解为一种足以促成整合的政治作用，这里所谓整合，就是把新地区纳入不断扩张的经济体系；其性质在很大程度上取决于任何特定地区与特定时代中，扩张的政治要素与经济要素之间种种变动着的关系。这里必须作两点限定。第一，帝国主义可能与经济整合只有间接联系：它有时越出经济发展地区之外，但那是为了对这些地区实施战略保护。第二，帝国主义是经济扩张的一种政治作用，经济扩张却未必需要它。帝国主义现象是否出现，不仅取决于经济扩张的因素，同样也取决于被纳入扩张型社会轨道的那些地区的政治与社会组织，还取决于总体世界局势。
en: Imperialism, perhaps, may be defined as a sufficient political function of this process of integrating new regions into the expanding economy; its character is largely decided by the various and changing relationships between the political and economic elements of expansion in any particular region and time. Two qualifications must be made. First, imperialism may be only indirectly connected with economic integration in that it sometimes extends beyond areas of economic development, but acts for their strategic protection. Secondly, although imperialism is a function of economic expansion, it is not a necessary function. Whether imperialist phenomena show themselves or not, is determined not only by the factors of economic expansion, but equally by the political and social organization of the regions brought into the orbit of the expansive society, and also by the world situation in general.

zh: 只有当这些新地区的政治体无法为商业整合或战略整合提供令人满意的条件、而它们的相对软弱又提供了可能时，才会诉诸帝国主义手段，动用权力来改变这些条件。诚然，经济扩张倾向于流向机会最大的地区，但机会最大既取决于利润问题，也取决于安全方面的政治考虑。因此，在任何特定地区，如果经济机会看似很大而政治保障看似很小，那么该地区被扩张中的经济完全吸纳的过程往往会受阻，直到外部势力对有关国家施压。反过来，以这种方式建立起令人满意的政治框架的程度越高，帝国主义干预的频率就越低，帝国主义的控制也就相应放松。可以提出：这种只把最高权力用于为贸易建立安全保障的意愿，正是十九世纪英国自由贸易的帝国主义的独特之处，与重商主义那种通过政治领有来获取商业优势与垄断的权力用法形成对照。
en: It is only when the polities of these new regions fail to provide satisfactory conditions for commercial or strategic integration and when their relative weakness allows, that power is used imperialistically to adjust those conditions. Economic expansion, it is true, will tend to flow into the regions of maximum opportunity, but maximum opportunity depends as much upon political considerations of security as upon questions of profit. Consequently, in any particular region, if economic opportunity seems large but political security small, then full absorption into the extending economy tends to be frustrated until power is exerted upon the state in question. Conversely, in proportion as satisfactory political frameworks are brought into being in this way, the frequency of imperialist intervention lessens and imperialist control is correspondingly relaxed. It may be suggested that this willingness to limit the use of paramount power to establishing security for trade is the distinctive feature of the British imperialism of free trade in the nineteenth century, in contrast to the mercantilist use of power to obtain commercial supremacy and monopoly through political possession.

zh: 按这一假设，英国的扩张或帝国主义不大可能用一套统一的年代分期来描述。并非所有地区在同一时间达到同一水平的经济整合；也并非所有地区在同一时间需要同一类型的政治控制。随着英国工业革命的壮大，新的市场与新的供给来源在不同时间与之相连，伴随这一过程的帝国主义行动程度也相应不同。于是，在维多利亚中期，正式帝国的重商主义手段正被用来开发印度，而同一时间、同一目的之下，非正式的自由贸易手段正被用于拉丁美洲。正因如此，想让帝国主义的阶段与宗主国经济增长的阶段直接对应起来的尝试，多半会落空。主张贸易条件或英国出口品性质的变化使这一过程必须发生急剧转变，只会掩盖英国扩张的根本连续性。
en: On this hypothesis the phasing of British expansion or imperialism is not likely to be chronological. Not all regions will reach the same level of economic integration at any one time; neither will all regions need the same type of political control at any one time. As the British industrial revolution grew, so new markets and sources of supply were linked to it at different times, and the degree of imperialist action accompanying that process varied accordingly. Thus mercantilist techniques of formal empire were being employed to develop India in the mid-Victorian age at the same time as informal techniques of free trade were being used in Latin America for the same purpose. It is for this reason that attempts to make phases of imperialism correspond directly to phases in the economic growth of the metropolitan economy are likely to prove in vain. The fundamental continuity of British expansion is only obscured by arguing that changes in the terms of trade or in the character of British exports necessitated a sharp change in the process.

zh: 从这个立足点看，英国工业社会多面的扩张可以被当作一个整体来观察，正式帝国与非正式帝国都只是其中的组成部分。二者于是都是在不断扩展的海外贸易、投资、移民和文化格局中，因情形而异的政治作用。如果这一点成立，那么正式帝国与非正式帝国在本质上是相互关联的，并在一定程度上可以互相替换。这样一来，不仅那种旧的、法律主义的、狭窄的帝国观念不能令人满意，把非正式帝国当作一种独立的、非政治的扩张范畴的旧观念同样不能令人满意。一种未能揭示非正式帝国与正式帝国之间深层统一性的非正式帝国概念是贫瘠的。只有在扩张的总体框架内，十九世纪的帝国才可以理解。因此我们面对的任务是：重新塑造那些解释——它们分别来自把宪制帝国看成有机整体的有缺陷观念，以及霍布森式的"帝国主义"概念。
en: From this vantage point the many-sided expansion of British industrial society can be viewed as a whole of which both the formal and informal empires are only parts. Both of them then appear as variable political functions of the extending pattern of overseas trade, investment, migration and culture. If this is accepted, it follows that formal and informal empire are essentially interconnected and to some extent interchangeable. Then not only is the old, legalistic, narrow idea of empire unsatisfactory, but so is the old idea of informal empire as a separate, non-political category of expansion. A concept of informal empire which fails to bring out the underlying unity between it and the formal empire is sterile. Only within the total framework of expansion is nineteenth-century empire intelligible. So we are faced with the task of re-fashioning the interpretations resulting from defective concepts of organic constitutional empire on the one hand and Hobsonian 'imperialism' on the other.

zh: 这一时期非正式帝国的经济重要性——甚至其优势地位——已被强调得足够多了。被忽略的是它的经济手段与政治手段之间的相互作用：政治行动如何助成商业优势的成长，而这种优势又如何反过来加强政治影响。换句话说，我们必须在叙述非正式帝国时兼顾它的政治与经济。从历史上看，这两个因素之间的关系既微妙又复杂。它绝不是什么为了英国贸易的事业而用炮舰摧毁一个顽抗国家的简单情形。扩张中的经济与它的正式或非正式依附地之间政治纽带（lien）的类型，不出所料，是有弹性的。实践中，这种纽带往往随下列条件而变：该地区的经济价值，其政治结构的强度，其统治者配合英国商业或战略目的的意愿，当地社会在没有外部控制的情况下经历经济变迁的能力，国内与国外政治局势允许英国干预的程度，最后还有欧洲竞争者在多大程度上让英国有放手行事的余地。
en: The economic importance—even the pre-eminence—of informal empire in this period has been stressed often enough. What was overlooked was the inter-relation of its economic and political arms; how political action aided the growth of commercial supremacy, and how this supremacy in turn strengthened political influence. In other words, it is the politics as well as the economics of the informal empire which we have to include in the account. Historically, the relationship between these two factors has been both subtle and complex. It has been by no means a simple case of the use of gunboats to demolish a recalcitrant state in the cause of British trade. The type of political

between the expanding economy and its formal or informal dependencies, as might be expected, has been flexible. In practice it has tended to vary with the economic value of the territory, the strength of its political structure, the readiness of its rulers to collaborate with British commercial or strategic purposes, the ability of the native society to undergo economic change without external control, the extent to which domestic and foreign political situations permitted British intervention, and, finally, how far European rivals allowed British policy a free hand.

zh: 因此，这条政治纽带从模糊的、非正式的最高控制权一直延伸到完全的政治领有；相应地，这些依附地中有些是正式殖民地，有些则不是。正式帝国与非正式帝国之间的区别，不是性质上的根本区别，而是程度上的区别。一个地区如此轻易地从一种地位滑向另一种地位，正好印证了这一点。例如，在过去两百年里，印度已从同联合王国的非正式结合转为正式结合，而二战以后又退回到一种非正式的关系。同样，英属西非已经历了前两个阶段，如今看来很可能步印度之后进入第三个阶段。
en: Accordingly, the political

has ranged from a vague, informal paramountcy to outright political possession; and, consequently, some of these dependent territories have been formal colonies whereas others have not. The difference between formal and informal empire has not been one of fundamental nature but of degree. The ease with which a region has slipped from one status to the other helps to confirm this. Within the last two hundred years, for example, India has passed from informal to formal association with the United Kingdom and, since World War II, back to an informal connexion. Similarly, British West Africa has passed through the first two stages and seems to-day likely to follow India into the third.

zh: III
en: III

zh: 现在让我们试着采用上述把英国扩张视为一个整体的观念，来重述近代英国扩张史的主要主题。我们已经看到，对这一过程的解释一旦只以正式政治标准为据，就陷入矛盾。如果把正式与非正式两种扩张当作同一个过程来考察，这些矛盾会消失吗？
en: Let us now attempt, tentatively, to use the concept of the totality of British expansion described above to restate the main themes of the history of modern British expansion. We have seen that interpretations of this process fall into contradictions when based upon formal political criteria alone. If expansion both formal and informal is examined as a single process, will these contradictions disappear?

zh: 英国工业的成长对英国政策提出了新要求。它必须把未开发地区同英国的对外贸易连接起来，而在这样做的过程中，就需要动用政治手段去强行打开那些被外国垄断势力关闭的市场。
en: The growth of British industry made new demands upon British policy. It necessitated linking undeveloped areas with British foreign trade and, in so doing, moved the political arm to force an entry into markets closed by the power of foreign monopolies.

zh: 正如哈洛教授所揭示的

，英国政策在失去北美殖民地之前就以这种方式积极活动，但它最大的机会出现在拿破仑战争期间。夺取法属与西属西印度群岛、1806 年对布宜诺斯艾利斯的擅自发动的武装远征、1811 年攻取爪哇，都是通过政治行动打进新地区、取得新资源的尝试。但这一政策走的不只是破门而入这一步：一旦门被打开、从英国输入的商品及其政治影响源源涌入，它们就可能使这道门再也关不上。例如，莱佛士一度打破了荷兰对爪哇香料贸易的垄断，向自由贸易开放了该岛。后来他又通过创建新加坡，使英国开始在马六甲贸易航路和马来半岛确立非正式的最高控制权。与此同时，在南美洲，英国政策的目标是为了贸易而对新地区实行间接的政治霸权。英国海军在与拿破仑决裂之后把葡萄牙王室送到了巴西，而英国驻当地的代表则从感激英国庇护的葡萄牙当局手中强取了 1810 年通商条约，使英国货物进入巴西时缴纳的关税低于宗主国葡萄牙的货物。条约中还加了一条深思熟虑的规定："本现行条约不限期限，其中明示或默示的义务与条件应永久不变。"
en: British policy, as Professor Harlow has shown,

was active in this way before the American colonies had been lost, but its greatest opportunities came during the Napoleonic Wars. The seizure of the French and Spanish West Indies, the filibustering expedition to Buenos Aires in 1806, the taking of Java in 1811, were all efforts to break into new regions and to tap new resources by means of political action. But the policy went further than simple house-breaking, for once the door was opened and British imports with their political implications were pouring in, they might stop the door from being shut again. Raffles, for example, temporarily broke the Dutch monopoly of the spice trade in Java and opened the island to free trade. Later, he began the informal British paramountcy over the Malacca trade routes and the Malay peninsula by founding Singapore. In South America, at the same time, British policy was aiming at indirect political hegemony over new regions for the purposes of trade. The British navy carried the Portuguese royal family to Brazil after the breach with Napoleon, and the British representative there extorted from his grateful clients the trade treaty of 1810 which left British imports paying a lower tariff than the goods of the mother country. The thoughtful stipulation was added 'that the Present Treaty shall be unlimited in point of duration, and that the obligations and conditions expressed or implied in it shall be perpetual and immutable'.

zh: 从 1810 年起，这一政策在拉丁美洲获得了更好的机会，而这些机会都被抓住了。英国政府设法利用殖民地革命来击碎西班牙的贸易垄断，取得非正式的优势地位，并取得那将有利于英国商业渗透的善意。坎宁在 1824 年敲定承认政策时说过："西属美洲已经自由了，除非我们把自己的事办得一塌糊涂，她就是英国的了。"
坎宁的深层目标，是通过创建一个非正式的帝国来为英国惊人的扩张开辟道路，以便不仅纠正旧世界的均势，还要恢复英国在新世界的影响。他得意地写道："事情已经办成了……扬基人会欢呼胜利：但真正因我们的决定而损失最大的正是他们……美国抢先一步也是白搭；我们使美洲重新与欧洲相连。"
很难想象还有比这更壮观的例子，既是为高层政治利益而实行商业霸权的政策，又是为商业企业的利益而运用非正式政治优势的政策。颇具标志性的是，英国对布宜诺斯艾利斯、墨西哥和哥伦比亚的承认，采取的是同它们签订通商条约的形式。
en: From 1810 onwards this policy had even better chances in Latin America, and they were taken. British governments sought to exploit the colonial revolutions to shatter the Spanish trade monopoly, and to gain informal supremacy and the good will which would all favour British commercial penetration. As Canning put it in 1824, when he had clinched the policy of recognition: 'Spanish America is free and if we do not mismanage our affairs sadly she is English.'

Canning's underlying object was to clear the way for a prodigious British expansion by creating a new and informal empire, not only to redress the Old World balance of power but to restore British influence in the New. He wrote triumphantly: 'The thing is done... the Yankees will shout in triumph: but it is they who lose most by our decision... the United States have gotten the start of us in vain; and we link once more America to Europe.'

It would be hard to imagine a more spectacular example of a policy of commercial hegemony in the interests of high politics, or of the use of informal political supremacy in the interests of commercial enterprise. Characteristically, the British recognition of Buenos Aires, Mexico and Colombia took the form of signing commercial treaties with them.

zh: 在维多利亚中期，无论在正式依附地还是在非正式依附地，都有大量努力打开大陆腹地，把英国的影响从港口向内地延伸，并开发腹地。
en: In both the formal and informal dependencies in the mid-Victorian age there was much effort to open the continental interiors and to extend the British influence inland from the ports and to develop the hinterlands.

zh: 这种开发的总体战略，是把这些地区转变为互补的卫星经济体：它们为英国提供原料与粮食，也为英国的制成品提供不断扩大的市场。正统解释要我们相信，这一时期扩张中的政治作用已停歇，甚至在衰退。而实际上，只要把非正式方面的发展考虑进来，那种所谓的无所作为就显出是一种幻觉。一旦强行打进了拉丁美洲、中国和巴尔干，任务就是鼓励建立稳定的政府，使当地成为投资风险较低的地方；正如在较弱或不令人满意的国家，人们认为有必要强迫它们采取更配合的态度。
en: The general strategy of this development was to convert these areas into complementary satellite economies, which would provide raw materials and food for Great Britain, and also provide widening markets for its manufactures. This was the period, the orthodox interpretation would have us believe, in which the political arm of expansion was dormant or even withered. In fact, that alleged inactivity is seen to be a delusion if we take into account the development in the informal aspect. Once entry had been forced into Latin America, China and the Balkans, the task was to encourage stable governments as good investment risks, just as in weaker or unsatisfactory states it was considered necessary to coerce them into more co-operative attitudes.

zh: 不过在拉丁美洲，有过几次起步失败。英国扩张在阿根廷的冲击助推了宪制的崩溃并把人民抛入内战，因为英国贸易使沿海兴旺，而内地遭到榨取、落在后面。1827 年的投资崩溃和潘帕斯人对布宜诺斯艾利斯的成功反抗
，阻断了英国的进一步扩张；罗萨斯将军上台，则毁掉了坎宁战略出色地搭建起来的制度框架。新政权不配合，它对蒙得维的亚的图谋在拉普拉塔河一带造成混乱，结果这条伟大的商业动脉便对经商活动关闭了。所有这一切在 1840 年代引发了一系列英国的直接干预，力图让河上的贸易重新运转；但事实上，在这里，使贸易局面恢复并令罗萨斯下台的，更多是英国贸易本身的吸引力，其作用大于英国政府采取的非正式帝国主义干预。
en: In Latin America, however, there were several false starts. The impact of British expansion in Argentina helped to wreck the constitution and throw the people into civil war, since British trade caused the sea-board to prosper while the back lands were exploited and lagged behind. The investment crash of 1827 and the successful revolt of the pampas people against Buenos Aires

blocked further British expansion, and the rise to power of General Rosas ruined the institutional framework which Canning's strategy had so brilliantly set up. The new regime was unco-operative and its designs on Montevideo caused chaos around the Rio de la Plata, which led to that great commercial artery being closed to enterprise. All this provoked a series of direct British interventions during the 1840's in efforts to get trade moving again on the river, but in fact it was the attractive force of British trade itself, more than the informal imperialist action of British governments, which in this case restored the situation by removing Rosas from power.

zh: 英国在巴西的政策碰到了特殊的麻烦，原因在于它不讲究策略地试图胁迫里约热内卢政府废除奴隶制。尽管英国在经济上占优势，其政治效力仍被英国国内人道主义压力团体的干预所削弱。然而 1856 年以后，对巴西的经济控制因铁路的修筑而加强了；这些由英国公司兴建、出资并经营的铁路，得到了巴西政府慷慨特许权的鼓励。
en: British policy in Brazil ran into peculiar troubles through its tactless attempt to browbeat the Government of Rio de Janeiro into abolishing slavery. British political effectiveness was weakened, in spite of economic predominance, by the interference of humanitarian pressure groups in England. Yet the economic control over Brazil was strengthened after 1856 by the building of the railways; these—begun, financed and operated by British companies—were encouraged by generous concessions from the government of Brazil.

zh: 随着铁路与轮船的发展，主要拉丁美洲国家的经济终于顺利接入世界经济。一旦它们的出口开始上升并吸引到外国投资，快速的经济增长就成为可能。即便在 1880 年代，在世界肉价与麦价下跌的情况下，阿根廷仍能使出口翻倍、使外债增至七倍。
到 1913 年，就整个拉丁美洲而言，非正式帝国主义对英国经济已重要到这种程度：投往该地区的 £999,000,000（9.99 亿英镑），超过英国海外投资总额的四分之一。
en: With the development of railways and steamships, the economies of the leading Latin American states were at last geared successfully to the world economy. Once their exports had begun to climb and foreign investment had been attracted, a rapid rate of economic growth was feasible. Even in the 1880's Argentina could double her exports and increase sevenfold her foreign indebtedness while the world price of meat and wheat was falling.

By 1913, in Latin America as a whole, informal imperialism had become so important for the British economy that £999,000,000, over a quarter of the total investment abroad, was invested in that region.

zh: 但这种投资，出于自然，集中在阿根廷、巴西这类国家——这些国家的政府（即便在 1891 年阿根廷违约之后）一直配合英国扩张的总体事业。因此，没有必要为了英国利益而采取强硬或专断的干预。因为一旦这些国家的经济充分依赖对外贸易，其繁荣取自该贸易的阶级通常就会亲自介入当地政治，以维护这种贸易所需的当地政治条件。而且，一旦美国能让其他列强认真对待门罗主义，英国的干预就变得更为困难。对商业帝国中最可靠成员事务的积极干预之放松，与对正式帝国中那些成功到足以取得自治的地区放弃直接政治控制，是相互匹配的。但在拉丁美洲，英国政府必要时仍然干预，以保护英国在较落后国家的利益：1870 年代曾为危地马拉和哥伦比亚的债券持有人干预，1910 至 1914 年间，也曾为墨西哥和洪都拉斯的债券持有人进行干预。
en: But this investment, as was natural, was concentrated in such countries as Argentina and Brazil whose governments (even after the Argentine default of 1891) had collaborated in the general task of British expansion. For this reason there was no need for brusque or peremptory interventions on behalf of British interests. For once their economies had become sufficiently dependent on foreign trade the classes whose prosperity was drawn from that trade normally worked themselves in local politics to preserve the local political conditions needed for it. British intervention, in any case, became more difficult once the United States could make other powers take the Monroe doctrine seriously. The slackening in active intervention in the affairs of the most reliable members of the commercial empire was matched by the abandonment of direct political control over those regions of formal empire which were successful enough to receive self-government. But in Latin America, British governments still intervened, when necessary, to protect British interests in the more backward states; there was intervention on behalf of the bond holders in Guatemala and Colombia in the 'seventies, as in Mexico and Honduras between 1910 and 1914.

zh: 非正式帝国采取的形式、试图利用的情势各不相同，取得的成效也有差异。尽管商业渗透与资本渗透倾向于带来政治合作与霸权，却有显著的例外。例如在美国，英国企业把以棉花生产为主的美国南方变成了一种殖民地经济，英国投资者希望对中西部作同样的事。但这个国家自身的政治力量挡在了他面前。美国的工业化不可能被阻止，已经工业化的地区发起运动，成功争取到了关税保护，尽管那些依赖英国贸易联系的地区反对。同样，美国的政治力量挫败了英国把得克萨斯、墨西哥和中美洲建立为非正式依附地的企图。
en: The types of informal empire and the situations it attempted to exploit were as various as the success which it achieved. Although commercial and capital penetration tended to lead to political co-operation and hegemony, there are striking exceptions. In the United States, for example, British business turned the cotton South into a colonial economy, and the British investor hoped to do the same with the Mid-West. But the political strength of the country stood in his way. It was impossible to stop American industrialization, and the industrialized sections successfully campaigned for tariffs, despite the opposition of those sections which depended on the British trade connexion. In the same way, American political strength thwarted British attempts to establish Texas, Mexico and Central America as informal dependencies.

zh: 反过来，英国扩张有时也会失败，如果它取得了政治优势却没有实现成功的商业渗透。英国政策在中国有过壮观的施展，但很少造就新的客户。英国对中国的政治控制没能打破中国的经济自给自足。1840 年的鸦片战争、1857 年的再度开战，拓宽了英国贸易的入口，却没能使中国的出口动起来。从英国角度看，它们的主要效果是不幸的：正如太平天国运动明白无误地显示的，这种外来压力使中国社会承受了巨大紧张。
值得注意的是，伦敦把中国政权的这种脆弱看作棘手的负担，而不是看作榨取更多特权的杠杆。事实上，英国人设法支撑摇摇欲坠的北京政权，因为正如克拉伦登勋爵 1870 年所说，"英国在中国的利益严格说来是商业的，或者至少只在保护商业的范围内才是政治的"。
此后几十年里，这种自我克制的价值显露出来：面临被列强瓜分的北京政府，越来越倚重英国作为公允斡旋者给予的外交支持。
en: Conversely, British expansion sometimes failed, if it gained political supremacy without effecting a successful commercial penetration. There were spectacular exertions of British policy in China, but they did little to produce new customers. Britain's political hold upon China failed to break down Chinese economic self-sufficiency. The Opium War of 1840, the renewal of war in 1857, widened the inlets for British trade but they did not get Chinese exports moving. Their main effect was an unfortunate one from the British point of view, for such foreign pressures put Chinese society under great strains as the Taiping Rebellion unmistakably showed.

It is important to note that this weakness was regarded in London as an embarrassment, and not as a lever for extracting further concessions. In fact, the British worked to prop up the tottering Pekin regime, for as Lord Clarendon put it in 1870, 'British interests in China are strictly commercial, or at all events only so far political as they may be for the protection of commerce'.

The value of this self-denial became clear in the following decades when the Pekin government, threatened with a scramble for China, leaned more and more on the diplomatic support of the honest British broker.

zh: 仅仅把这些由政治行动以这种或那种形式协助、支持的经济扩张案例罗列出来，就足以暴露通行理论的站不住脚——那种认为自由贸易可以不要帝国的理论。上文已经说明，自由贸易并未摆脱帝国。维多利亚中期的经济扩张，有一种相应的政治扩张与之匹配，而这种政治扩张之所以被忽略，是因为那种据说是"会把神志正常的人逼疯"的读图研究看不见它。从维多利亚中期伦敦与白人定居殖民地之间的和睦，推出英国不愿在英国利益的领域干预，是荒谬的。广州城下的军舰与加拿大的责任政府同样是这个时代的组成部分；旁遮普的战场与废除寡妇殉夫制（suttee）同样是真实的。
en: The simple recital of these cases of economic expansion, aided and abetted by political action in one form or other, is enough to expose the inadequacy of the conventional theory that free trade could dispense with empire. We have seen that it did not do so. Economic expansion in the mid-Victorian age was matched by a corresponding political expansion which has been overlooked because it could not be seen by that study of maps which, it has been said, drives sane men mad. It is absurd to deduce from the harmony between London and the colonies of white settlement in the mid-Victorian age any British reluctance to intervene in the fields of British interests. The warships at Canton are as much a part of the period as responsible government for Canada; the battlefields of the Punjab are as real as the abolition of suttee.

zh: 维多利亚中期远不是一个"冷漠"的时代，它是英国海外扩张史上具有决定意义的阶段，因为商业渗透与政治影响的结合，使联合王国得以支配那些最容易被安排进自身经济的外部经济。为实现这种支配，人们采用了适应不同条件、起于不同时间的种种手段。以新加坡为中心，在马来亚建立起最高控制权；从拉各斯港向外延伸出对西非大部分地区的宗主权，并由非洲分舰队为之撑腰。在东非海岸，英国在桑给巴尔的影响——由于柯克领事的努力而居于支配地位——使英国得以利用阿拉伯人在非洲大陆原有的统治地位。
en: Far from being an era of 'indifference', the mid-Victorian years were the decisive stage in the history of British expansion overseas, in that the combination of commercial penetration and political influence allowed the United Kingdom to command those economies which could be made to fit best into her own. A variety of techniques adapted to diverse conditions and beginning at different dates were employed to effect this domination. A paramountcy was set up in Malaya centred on Singapore; a suzerainty over much of West Africa reached out from the port of Lagos and was backed up by the African squadron. On the east coast of Africa British influence at Zanzibar, dominant thanks to the exertions of Consul Kirk, placed the heritage of Arab command on the mainland at British disposal.

zh: 但英国扩张最常见的政治手段，或许还是同较弱国家缔结或强加于它的通商与友好条约。1836 年和 1857 年的波斯条约、1838 年和 1861 年的土耳其条约、1858 年的日本条约，从桑给巴尔、暹罗和摩洛哥榨取的特权，非洲酋长们以十字画押的数百项反奴隶制条约——所有这些条约都使英国政府得以推进同这些地区的贸易。
en: But perhaps the most common political technique of British expansion was the treaty of free trade and friendship made with or imposed upon a weaker state. The treaties with Persia of 1836 and 1857, the Turkish treaties of 1838 and 1861, the Japanese treaty of 1858, the favours extracted from Zanzibar, Siam and Morocco, the hundreds of anti-slavery treaties signed with crosses by African chiefs—all these treaties enabled the British government to carry forward trade with these regions.

zh: 甚至同某一地区的高价值贸易，也可能让位于同另一地区类似的贸易——后者在政治上更容易被强迫。例如，俄国的粮食贸易对英国极为有用。但俄国人根本不听自由贸易这套，英国又无法把他们拖进来，于是英国转而开发奥斯曼帝国的粮食供应，因为在君士坦丁堡的英国压力已经能把土耳其人推进一项自由的贸易政策。
商业扩张对政治手段的依赖，造成了一种普遍趋势：英国贸易跟着非正式帝国的无形旗帜走。
en: Even a valuable trade with one region might give place to a similar trade with another which could be more easily coerced politically. The Russian grain trade, for example, was extremely useful to Great Britain. But the Russians' refusal to hear of free trade, and the British inability to force them into it, caused efforts to develop the grain of the Ottoman empire instead, since British pressure at Constantinople had been able to hustle the Turk into a liberal trade policy.
The dependence of the commercial thrust upon the political arm resulted in a general tendency for British trade to follow the invisible flag of informal empire.

zh: 既然维多利亚中期如今显出是一个大规模扩张的时代，我们对所谓"帝国主义"时代的评价也必须加以修正。接受"经济帝国主义"概念的人要我们相信：世纪末的兼并代表着政策上的急剧断裂，其原因在于自由贸易的衰落、保护海外投资的需要，以及政治家们转而相信必须无限制地攫取土地。这些解释都可置疑。第一，英国的关税政策并未改变。第二，英国海外投资并非新事物，而且其中大部分仍在流向正式帝国之外的地区。最后，即便往大处说，政治家们也只在一定程度上接受了大规模兼并政策。直到 1887 年为止，政党领袖对扩大英国统治的热情并不比维多利亚中期的政治家高多少。在 1887 年以后，有时仍是如此。索尔兹伯里对主张扩张的那些"狂热者"的"表面慈善"与"无赖行径"感到愤怒。
1888 年有人促他援助尼亚萨兰的传教站时，他反驳说："这不是我们的责任。我们本会为了一项极可疑的收益而冒着巨大牺牲的风险。"
1888 年以后，索尔兹伯里、罗斯伯里和张伯伦把瓜分非洲看作一种痛苦但不可避免的必需，它起源于外来扩张的威胁，以及贸易不可抑制地要溢出帝国边界、把政府拖进新的、恼人的承诺的倾向。但直到 1898 年，他们才自信到足以着手重新征服苏丹这样至关重要的地区。
en: Since the mid-Victorian age now appears as a time of large-scale expansion, it is necessary to revise our estimate of the so-called 'imperialist' era as well. Those who accept the concept of 'economic imperialism' would have us believe that the annexations at the end of the century represented a sharp break in policy, due to the decline of free trade, the need to protect foreign investment, and the conversion of statesmen to the need for unlimited land-grabbing. All these explanations are questionable. In the first place, the tariff policy of Great Britain did not change. Again, British foreign investment was no new thing and most of it was still flowing into regions outside the formal empire. Finally the statesmens' conversion to the policy of extensive annexation was partial, to say the most of it. Until 1887, and only occasionally after that date, party leaders showed little more enthusiasm for extending British rule than the mid-Victorians. Salisbury was infuriated by the 'superficial philanthropy' and 'roguery' of the 'fanatics' who advocated expansion.
When pressed to aid the missions in Nyasaland in 1888, he retorted: 'It is not our duty to do it. We should be risking tremendous sacrifices for a very doubtful gain.'

After 1888, Salisbury, Rosebery and Chamberlain accepted the scramble for Africa as a painful but unavoidable necessity which arose from a threat of foreign expansion and the irrepressible tendency of trade to overflow the bounds of empire, dragging the government into new and irksome commitments. But it was not until 1898 that they were sufficiently confident to undertake the reconquest of so vital a region as the Sudan.

zh: 面对列强夺取此前向英国商人开放的热带地区的前景，伦敦的当政者一个接一个地采取权宜之计，以避开正式扩张的需要，同时在那些地区维护英国的最高控制权。维多利亚晚期同中期一样，英国政策宁愿用非正式手段来扩大帝国的优势地位，而不是直接统治。在这两个所谓时期里，扩大英国统治始终是最后手段——正是这种偏好，产生了维多利亚时代大臣们那些大量"反扩张"的言论。这些常被引用的说法所掩盖的是：实践中，无论维多利亚中期还是晚期的决策者，当非正式手段无法提供保障时，都不拒绝把正式统治的保护扩展到英国利益之上。在中叶的局势下非正式手段更常足以达到这一目的，而在后期外国对英国优势的挑战加剧时较少足以达到这一目的——这一事实不应被用来掩饰政策的基本连续性。自始至终，英国政府都用最适应其各不相同的利益地区局势的手段，来建立并维护英国的最高控制权。维多利亚中叶诸人的目标并不比他们的后继者更"反帝国主义"，尽管他们更常能以非正式方式达成；而维多利亚晚期诸人也不比其前辈更"帝国主义"，尽管他们被迫更常诉诸兼并。英国政策遵循的原则是：可能时以非正式方式扩大控制，必要时以正式方式扩大控制。把前一种方法贴上"反帝国主义"的标签、把后一种贴上"帝国主义"的标签，就是无视这样一个事实：无论采用哪种方法，英国的利益都在稳步地得到维护和扩展。人们通常把自由贸易帝国的政策概括为"贸易而非统治"，这句概括应改为"可能时在非正式控制下开展贸易，必要时在正式统治下开展贸易"。这一关于政策连续性的表述，也就瓦解了正统解释中那个过于简化的"非自愿扩张"说——它以两个时期之间的断裂为依据。
en: Faced with the prospect of foreign acquisitions of tropical territory hitherto opened to British merchants, the men in London resorted to one expedient after another to evade the need of formal expansion and still uphold British paramountcy in those regions. British policy in the late, as in the mid-Victorian period preferred informal means of extending imperial supremacy rather than direct rule. Throughout the two alleged periods the extension of British rule was a last resort—and it is this preference which has given rise to the many 'anti-expansionist' remarks made by Victorian ministers. What these much quoted expressions obscure, is that in practice mid-Victorian as well as late-Victorian policy makers did not refuse to extend the protection of formal rule over British interests when informal methods had failed to give security. The fact that informal techniques were more often sufficient for this purpose in the circumstances of the mid-century than in the later period when the foreign challenge to British supremacy intensified, should not be allowed to disguise the basic continuity of policy. Throughout, British governments worked to establish and maintain British paramountcy by whatever means best suited the circumstances of their diverse regions of interest. The aims of the mid-Victorians were no more 'anti-imperialist' than their successors', though they were more often able to achieve them informally; and the late-Victorians were no more 'imperialist' than their predecessors, even though they were driven to annex more often. British policy followed the principle of extending control informally if possible and formally if necessary. To label the one method 'anti-imperialist' and the other 'imperialist', is to ignore the fact that whatever the method British interests were steadily safeguarded and extended. The usual summing up of the policy of the free trade empire as 'trade not rule' should read 'trade with informal control if possible; trade with rule when necessary'. This statement of the continuity of policy disposes of the over-simplified explanation of involuntary expansion inherent in the orthodox interpretation based on the discontinuity between the two periods.

zh: 因此在所谓"帝国主义"时代，无论是索尔兹伯里还是格拉斯通，无论是楠茨福德还是德比和里彭，在承认进一步兼并不可避免之前，都穷尽了所有非正式的权宜之计来确保英国在非洲的贸易地区。一种办法是把自由贸易与准入的保证，作为承认外国领土要求的回报取得；这一办法的好处在于，把统治的担子加给外国政府，同时让英国人享有商业上的优势。1884 年英葡条约、1885 年刚果安排、1886 年关于东非的英德协定，都是这样做的。另一种逃避扩大统治的办法，是由外国列强承认的独占势力范围或保护领。尽管这类安排起初并不附带平定或治理这些地区的责任，但随着国际法的变化，1885 年以后它们确实附带了这种责任。1881 年至 1889 年间向私人公司颁发特许状，授权它们在帝国许可下治理新地区并为此筹措经费，标志着支持英国商业扩张的手段由非正式向正式的转变。尽管有这些"廉价帝国主义"的尝试，外国在热带非洲对英国最高控制权的挑战，加上那里相对缺少在其他地方曾很好地服务于非正式扩张的大规模、强固的本土政治组织，最终决定了向正式统治的转变。
en: Thus Salisbury as well as Gladstone, Knutsford as well as Derby and Ripon, in the so-called age of 'imperialism', exhausted all informal expedients to secure regions of British trade in Africa before admitting that further annexations were unavoidable. One device was to obtain guarantees of free trade and access as a reward for recognizing foreign territorial claims, a device which had the advantage of saddling foreign governments with the liability of rule whilst allowing Britons the commercial advantage. This was done in the Anglo-Portuguese Treaty of 1884, the Congo Arrangement of 1885, and the Anglo-German Agreement over East Africa in 1886. Another device for evading the extension of rule was the exclusive sphere of influence or protectorate recognized by foreign powers. Although originally these imposed no liability for pacifying or administering such regions, with changes in international law they did so after 1885. The granting of charters to private companies between 1881 and 1889, authorizing them to administer and finance new regions under imperial licence, marked the transition from informal to formal methods of backing British commercial expansion. Despite these attempts at 'imperialism on the cheap', the foreign challenge to British paramountcy in tropical Africa and the comparative absence there of large-scale, strong, indigenous political organizations which had served informal expansion so well elsewhere, eventually dictated the switch to formal rule.

zh: 于是有一条原则清楚显现：只有在非正式政治手段不足以给英国事业（无论是商业的、慈善的还是纯粹战略的）提供安全保障的框架时，建立正式帝国的问题才会出现。在欧洲人后裔的卫星地区，例如拉丁美洲或加拿大，强大的政府结构成长起来了；而在完全非欧洲的地区，扩张则在本土结构上释放出如此巨大的破坏力量，以至于这些结构往往在持续被利用的过程中逐渐失效乃至瓦解。许多情况下，正是这一趋势说明了英国非正式责任的扩大，并最终说明了由间接控制向直接控制的转变。
en: One principle then emerges plainly: it is only when and where informal political means failed to provide the framework of security for British enterprise (whether commercial, or philanthropic or simply strategic) that the question of establishing formal empire arose. In satellite regions peopled by European stock, in Latin America or Canada, for instance, strong governmental structures grew up; in totally non-European areas, on the other hand, expansion unleashed such disruptive forces upon the indigenous structures that they tended to wear out and even collapse with use. This tendency in many cases accounts for the extension of informal British responsibility and eventually for the change from indirect to direct control.

zh: 正是在非洲，这一过渡过程在 1880 年以后的时期表现得最为显著。到 1870 年代，外国贷款和掠夺性的银行家已经毁坏了埃及的财政，并在埃及的政治织体上撕开了口子。英法财政共管本是为保护外国债券持有人、使埃及重新成为信用可靠的借款国而设计的，却激起了反欧情绪。随着 1881 年阿拉比帕夏的起事，赫迪夫政府既不能再保障至关重要的运河，也不能再保证外国投资人能索得那「一磅肉」。
en: It was in Africa that this process of transition manifested itself most strikingly during the period after 1880. Foreign loans and predatory bankers by the 1870's had wrecked Egyptian finances and were tearing holes in the Egyptian political fabric. The Anglo-French dual financial control, designed to safeguard the foreign bondholders and to restore Egypt as a good risk, provoked anti-European feeling. With the revolt of Arabi Pasha in 1881, the Khedive's government could serve no longer to secure either the all-important Canal or the foreign investors' pound of flesh.

zh: 1882 年英国占领行动的动机混乱而多样：早在迪斯雷利购买运河公司的股份之前就已显露的支配运河的愿望；债券持有人的利益；以及过分的忧虑——生怕任何外国列强、特别是法国利用埃及当时盛行的无政府状态，让其势力横在英国通往印度的航路上。格拉斯通的内阁几乎所有人都承认英国干预的必要性，尽管理由各不相同；而为了维系这个意见纷歧的内阁，首相同意了。
en: The motives for the British occupation of 1882 were confused and varied: the desire, evident long before Disraeli's purchase of shares, to dominate the Canal; the interests of the bondholders; and the over-anxiety to forestall any foreign power, especially France, from taking advantage of the prevailing anarchy in Egypt to interpose its power across the British road to India. Nearly all Gladstone's Cabinet admitted the necessity of British intervention, although for different reasons, and, in order to hold together his distracted ministry, the Prime Minister agreed.

zh: 英国远征的意图，是在赫迪夫名义上的统治之下、在非正式英国影响的轨道之内，恢复一个稳定的埃及政府。一旦做到这一点，按设想军队就应当撤出。但这次远征已经把埃及统治的结构打得粉碎，除英国直接动用武力之外，没有任何力量能使它成为非正式霸权与发展的可行而可靠的工具。于是，自由党政府遵循其计划——而这个计划不过是仓促之间从大臣们的分歧中演化出来——却滑入了它本打算避免的对埃及的长期占领。实际上，占领国不得不对这个国家的防务、债务和发展负直接责任。英国政策这种背反的效果，被格拉斯通忧郁地一语道尽："我们办完了埃及的事，我们自己却成了埃及的政府。"
因此，埃及是一个显著的例子，说明由于投资以及针对外国影响的伪民族主义反应对卫星国的侵蚀，一种非正式战略如何失灵了。
en: The British expedition was intended to restore a stable Egyptian government under the ostensible rule of the Khedive and inside the orbit of informal British influence. When this was achieved, the army, it was intended, should be withdrawn. But the expedition had so crushed the structure of Egyptian rule that no power short of direct British force could make it a viable and trustworthy instrument of informal hegemony and development. Thus the Liberal Government following its plan, which had been hastily evolved out of little more than ministerial disagreements, drifted into the prolonged occupation of Egypt it was intent on avoiding. In fact, the occupying power became directly responsible for the defence, the debts and development of the country. The perverse effect of British policy was gloomily summed up by Gladstone: 'We have done our Egyptian business and we are an Egyptian government.'
Egypt, then, is a striking example of an informal strategy misfiring due to the undermining of the satellite state by investment and by pseudo-nationalist reaction against foreign influence.

zh: 就埃及问题同通往印度的航路以及印度帝国本身的防务紧密相连而言，英国政策在 1880 年代和 1890 年代把它放在最优先的地位。为了保卫英国贸易与帝国的脊柱，英国在热带非洲和太平洋的领土要求一再被当作更高层次博弈中的棋子而牺牲。例如，1884 年外交部认定，英国在埃及的易受攻击状态使它与外国列强在刚开始的瓜分西非的竞争中角力不明智；因此有人提议"……我们只限于在那〔西非〕海岸确保尽可能大的贸易自由，把领土责任让给别国……而在东海岸……寻求补偿，那里的政治前途对印度和帝国利益真正重要。"
英国政策并非无差别地抢占土地。事实上，英国渗入乌干达并控制尼罗河流域的其余部分，是一项高度有选择的计划，因为它把英国在西非的部分权益让给了法国，又把东非的一部分移交给了德国。
en: The Egyptian question, in so far as it was closely bound with the routes to India and the defence of the Indian empire itself, was given the highest priority by British policy in the 'eighties and 'nineties. In order to defend the spinal cord of British trade and empire, tropical African and Pacific claims were repeatedly sacrificed as pawns in the higher game. In 1884, for example, the Foreign Office decided that British vulnerability in Egypt made it unwise to compete with foreign powers in the opening scramble for West Africa; and it was therefore proposed '... to confine ourselves to securing the utmost possible freedom of trade on that [west] coast, yielding to others the territorial responsibilities... and seeking compensation on the east coast... where the political future of the country is of real importance to Indian and imperial interests.'

British policy was not one of indiscriminate land-grabbing. And, indeed, the British penetration into Uganda and their securing of the rest of the Nile Valley was a highly selective programme, in so far as it surrendered some British West African claims to France and transferred part of East Africa to Germany.

zh: 这样，维多利亚中期如今显出是一个大规模扩张的时代，而维多利亚晚期似乎并未向这一扩张过程引入任何重大的新东西。对广大未开发地区的兼并，曾被当作唯有这一时期才是大扩张时代的证据，如今其意义却黯然失色——至少，如果我们的分析大体符合实际。直接帝国统治的范围确实扩大了，但这是这一时期扩张最重要或最具特征的发展吗？非洲是欧洲渗透的最后一块场地，这一简单的历史事实并不等于说它是最重要的场地；这本是一句老生常谈，若不是霍布森学派的主要论据恰恰建立在非洲的例子之上，就不必多说。另一方面，我们的主要论点是：早在开发热带非洲这样边缘而末梢的场地之前，扩张过程早已达到了它最有价值的目标。因此，建立在瓜分非洲所采用的手段之上的种种论证，看来只具有次要的重要性。
en: Thus the mid-Victorian period now appears as an era of large-scale expansion, and the late-Victorian age does not seem to introduce any significant novelty into that process of expansion. The annexations of vast undeveloped territories, which have been taken as proof that this period alone was the great age of expansion, now pale in significance, at least if our analysis is anywhere near the truth. That the area of direct imperial rule was extended is true, but is it the most important or characteristic development of expansion during this period? The simple historical fact that Africa was the last field of European penetration is not to say that it was the most important; this would be a truism were it not that the main case of the Hobson school is founded on African examples. On the other hand, it is our main contention that the process of expansion had reached its most valuable targets long before the exploitation of so peripheral and marginal a field as tropical Africa. Consequently arguments, founded on the technique adopted in scrambling for Africa, would seem to be of secondary importance.

zh: 因此，寻求十九世纪末扩张之最深含义的历史学家，应当看的不是在非洲丛林与灌木丛中插桩圈地这类事情本身，而是当时正在印度、在拉丁美洲、在加拿大以及其他地方结出果实的帝国——正式帝国与非正式帝国——的成功开发。在所谓扩张主义时代，帝国主义的主要业绩，是对已经同世界经济联结起来的地区作更集约的开发，而不是对非洲其余边缘地区作外延式的兼并。最好的收获与战利品早已到手；在热带非洲，帝国主义者不过是在捞桶底最后一点剩余罢了。
en: Therefore, the historian who is seeking to find the deepest meaning of the expansion at the end of the nineteenth century should look not at the mere pegging out of claims in African jungles and bush, but at the successful exploitation of the empire, both formal and informal, which was then coming to fruition in India, in Latin America, in Canada and elsewhere. The main work of imperialism in the so-called expansionist era was in the more intensive development of areas already linked with the world economy, rather than in the extensive annexations of the remaining marginal regions of Africa. The best finds and prizes had already been made; in tropical Africa the imperialists were merely scraping the bottom of the barrel.
